apiDocs.title: API documentation
apiDocs.intro: JustPlay42 provides a public REST API for managing friends and user profiles. Requests and responses use JSON.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
paragraphs: Send every request over HTTPS to the host below. The endpoint paths on this page already include the /api prefix.

auth.title: Authentication
paragraphs: Every endpoint requires a valid access token. Log in with POST /api/users/login to receive one.
Send the token in the Authorization header of every request. Requests without a valid token are rejected with 401.

rateLimit.title: Rate limiting
paragraphs: Each client may send a limited number of requests per minute. Requests above the limit are rejected with 429 Too Many Requests.

errors.title: Errors

ft_transcendence is a student project created as part of the 42 Warsaw curriculum.

paragraphs: The application may collect the following information:
items: Technical information such as IP address and browser type
Session and cookie data required for authentication

sections.title: 3. How We Use Data
paragraphs: Collected data is used only for purposes related to the functionality of the application, including:

sections.title: 4. Cookies
paragraphs: ft_transcendence uses cookies and session storage to maintain user authentication and ensure proper functionality of the application.
A language cookie remembers the interface language chosen by the user.
Users can disable cookies in their browser settings, although some features of the application may stop working properly.

sections.title: 5. Data Storage and Security
paragraphs: We take reasonable technical measures to protect user data against unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction.
However, no internet transmission or electronic storage method is completely secure.

sections.title: 6. User Rights
paragraphs: Users may request access to their personal data, correction of inaccurate information, or deletion of their account and associated data.

sections.title: 7. Third-Party Services
paragraphs: ft_transcendence may use third-party authentication or hosting services required for application functionality.
These services may process data according to their own privacy policies.
